headline: Slack launches collaborative AI coding channels for teams
summary: New Slack Code channels allow teams to work with AI agents like Anthropic's Claude and Cognition's Devin to build features, fix bugs, and preview code changes.
details: Slack has introduced Slack Code, a new feature offering dedicated channels for teams to collaborate on coding tasks with AI agents. This aims to streamline the development process by keeping AI interactions within Slack, eliminating the need to switch between multiple tools.

Users can tag AI agents such as Anthropic's Claude or Cognition's Devin directly within a code channel. These agents will then spin up a dedicated space where team members can view conversations, audit code differences, and provide feedback on the AI's work before it's finalized.

Slack Code channels are designed to archive automatically once a task is completed, providing a clear audit log for record-keeping. This feature positions AI agents as integrated "teammates" within the collaborative workflow.

The new functionality integrates with AI agents available on Slack's marketplace. Founding partners like Claude Code, Devin, Vercel Agent, and GitHub Copilot will offer seamless integration with these code channels.
caption:
Slack is launching collaborative AI coding channels, allowing teams to work with agents like Claude and Devin directly within Slack.

Slack has introduced Slack Code, a new feature offering dedicated channels for teams to collaborate on coding tasks with AI agents. This aims to streamline the development process by keeping AI interactions within Slack, eliminating the need to switch between multiple tools.

Users can tag AI agents such as Anthropic's Claude or Cognition's Devin directly within a code channel. These agents will then spin up a dedicated space where team members can view conversations, audit code differences, and provide feedback on the AI's work before it's finalized.

Slack Code channels are designed to archive automatically once a task is completed, providing a clear audit log for record-keeping. This feature positions AI agents as integrated "teammates" within the collaborative workflow.

The new functionality integrates with AI agents available on Slack's marketplace. Founding partners like Claude Code, Devin, Vercel Agent, and GitHub Copilot will offer seamless integration with these code channels.
